title: Ancient DNA Extraction from Bones and Teeth
author: Michael V. Westbury
materials: Modified Binding Buffer Prepare in bulk Option 1 (with 5M NaOAc) 500 mL Buffer PB Qiagen Catalog #19066 9 mL 5M Sodium acetate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) 1.25 mL 5M Sodium chloride Fisher Scientific Catalog #10609823 Adjust to pH 4-5 (~2 mL Hydrochloric acid) Option 2 (with 3M NaOAc, pH 5.2) 500 mL Buffer PB Qiagen Catalog #19066 15 mL Sodium acetate buffer solution 3M pH 5.2 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #S7899 2.5 mL 5M Sodium chloride Fisher Scientific Catalog #10609823 No pH adjustment necessary as the 3M sodium acetate is pH buffered at pH5.2. The NaOAc and NaCl can be added directly to the 500 mL of Buffer PB. Make sure to label it as Modified Buffer PB . Make individual aliquots in 50 mL Falcon tubes.

EBT Buffer *optional Appropriate for when NOT using LoBind Eppendorf tubes. Buffer EB Qiagen Catalog #19086 Tween 20 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P1379-500ml at a final concentration of 0.05% (v/v)

Digestion Buffer Choose the appropriate option based on [ProK] . Prepare fresh for each use. 0.5M EDTA Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #03690 Proteinase K, recombinant, PCR Grade Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #RPROTKSOL-RO Option 1: Use 10mg/mL ProK Option 2: Use 19mg/mL ProK
EB Buffer Appropriate for when using LoBind Eppendorf tubes. Buffer EB Qiagen Catalog #19086 . Use as provided.

steps.title: Prepare PE Buffer
steps.instruction: Add Molecular Grade Ethanol to the PE buffer when opening a new bottle, following the instructions printed on the bottle.

steps.title: Optional DNA Quantification
steps.instruction: If desired, measure DNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer according to the Qubit protocol.

steps.title: Resuspend Sample in Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Place 50 mg bone powder into a 2 mL LoBind Eppendorf tube, add 1 mL extraction buffer, and vortex to resuspend.

steps.title: Initial Digestion Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal the tube with Parafilm, place on a rotation machine, and incubate at 50 °C with constant rotation for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pellet Bone Powder
steps.instruction: Remove Parafilm and centrifuge the tube at maximum speed for 2 minutes to pellet the bone powder.

steps.title: Second Extraction Buffer Wash
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 1 mL fresh extraction buffer, and vortex to resuspend the bone powder.

steps.title: Overnight Digestion
steps.instruction: Seal the tube with Parafilm, keep on the rotation machine, and incubate at 37 °C with constant rotation for ~18 hours (or overnight).

steps.title: Pellet After Overnight Digestion
steps.instruction: Remove Parafilm and centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 minutes to pellet the bone powder.

steps.title: Concentrate Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the ~1 mL supernatant to an Amicon® vivaspin 30 kDa filter (do not close the tube too tightly). Centrifuge at ~4,000 g until ~70 µL remains, starting with 10 minutes then 5‑minute intervals as needed; repeat the concentration cycle until the volume is reduced to ~70 µL or all sample is used.

substeps.instruction: Check volume; if >70 µL, continue with 5 min spins.
If volume does not reach ~70 µL after several spins, repeat the entire concentration step.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Mix the concentrated supernatant with 10× its volume of modified binding buffer in a Monarch spin column (e.g., 70 µL supernatant + 700 µL binding buffer); mix by pipetting or inverting.

steps.title: First Wash Spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 8,000 RPM for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and tap the collection tube on a paper towel to remove excess liquid before re‑assembling.

steps.title: PE Buffer Wash
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL PE buffer to the spin column.

steps.title: Second Wash Spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5,000 RPM for 1 minute and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Repeat Binding Wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the mixing of supernatant with 10× binding buffer (step 10) and the 8,000 RPM centrifugation (step 11) as needed.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 min at 8,000 RPM and discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry Spin Column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin column at maximum speed for 1 minute to dry the silica membrane.

steps.title: Transfer Column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into a clean 1.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 17.5 µL EB buffer (or EBT buffer if not using LoBind tubes) to the silica membrane and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect Eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 30 seconds and collect the eluate.

steps.title: Final Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution step (add 17.5 µL EB/EBT and centrifuge) until a total of 35 µL DNA extract is obtained; store the DNA at –20 °C.
